sections.title: How gustar works
sections.content: In English, you say *I like coffee*. In Spanish, the sentence structure is reversed: *Me gusta el café* literally means *Coffee is pleasing to me*. The object you like is actually the grammatical subject!
Always include the definite article (*el*, *la*) when naming general things with *gustar*: say *Me gusta el chocolate*, not *Me gusta chocolate*.
